question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating in each place?
premises: Meditation is performed in each and every place.
The object of meditation extends from Shiva down to Avici.
This range covers the entire cosmic spectrum.
inference: One should meditate in every place on that which extends from Shiva to Avici.
